title: Skill Composition Boundaries Within Build
summary: Build composes debug, refactor, and review as seamless mode shifts, not dispatched sub-workflows: each mode shift inherits the build session's orientation and current work package with no re-orientation, so skill boundaries are invisible during composition. Debug triggers on unexpected failures (errors unrelated to the current red-phase expectation, previously-passing tests breaking, behavior diverging from orientation); refactor triggers after green or at stewardship across the Three-Level Refactor; review triggers at stewardship checkpoints or on demand. Any skill can also be invoked standalone, running its own Context Gathering, with skill boundaries visible in that mode.
workflow_point: BUILD phase, composition boundaries between build/debug/refactor/review
mechanism: seamless mode shifts with full context inheritance (no re-orientation)

links.note: Preserves the review skill's standalone utility character established in ADR-043 even as its build-time integration is redefined by this ADR.
Supersedes ADR-046's callout-based review integration mechanics with a seamless mode-shift composition model, while preserving the review skill's standalone character.
Extends ADR-048's skill decomposition by specifying explicit composition boundaries, triggers, and context-inheritance rules for build's invocation of debug, refactor, and review.
